AITA for saying I’d pay 100% up front and then backing out of it | I designed a product and I am in the process of reaching out to influencers to promote it. One of the influencers has asked me to pay 100% up front ($263 USD) right now. The only problem is, I’ve never met this guy. He’s an internet stranger who lives in Serbia and for all I know, he could steal my money and run.

Also, I made the mistake of paying an influencer $750, all in advance. He disappeared for a month and was unresponsive to my emails. It wasn’t until I threatened to sue him that he grudgingly responded and asked me why I’m so stressed out. He said he couldn’t respond because he’s too busy, but funny enough he was quick to respond before he got my money.

So I said to the Serbian influencer, I’ll pay you half up front and the other half after you post my links. He responds and says that “I’m not like other influencers” and he demanded the full payment right now. I hate arguments and I’m not a confrontational person, so I replied and said that I’d pay him the full amount in advance.

After thinking about it all night last night, I wrote an email to the Serbian influencer explaining the bad experience I had with the other influencer and how I wasn’t comfortable with paying 100% up front. He still hasn’t responded, but I’m sure he’ll be super angry to find out that I backed out of my word.

So AITA?

AITA for killing my friend’s pet spider and refusing to pay for it? | My friend Megan (20F) is letting me crash at her place for the next few days. I got into a huge fight with my fiancé and got kicked out. I am extremely grateful that Megan is letting me stay with her while I figure things out with my fiancé and get back on my feet.

This morning I wanted to invite Megan out to lunch as a thank you. I went into her room to ask her and saw a huge ass spider on her bed just chilling. I screamed so loud I’m surprised I didn’t shatter every glass within a 10 mile radius and immediately grabbed the nearest object to kill it.

And then I squished it.

Megan ran out of the bathroom when I screamed and saw what happened. To my surprise she started crying! Apparently she had the spider out so she could clean its enclosure and it was her pet. It was also a very rare and exotic species that cost her a lot of money (hundreds of dollars).

She is extremely upset with me and is asking me to pay her for the spider. I am refusing because I feel like 1) there was NO way I could’ve know this was her pet and I had a normal human reaction and 2) she left her spider just chilling there and that’s on her.

She is pissed off and probably going to kick me out but I feel justified in my stance. AITA?

My boyfriends daughter (19) has enrolled in drivers ed to learn how to drive she has to document over 40 hours of driving. The last time I took her out driving she had nearly caused multiple car accidents from not listing/paying attention to the road.

AITA for going after a girl who rejected me until the point where the school intervened? | So, throwaway for obvious reasons.

This story consists of two people, me, and this girl. I need to get it straight that I loved her _a lot_. Like, I would have married her if we were older and going out. At the time I didn't regret any of this.

So it was the day before Valentine's Day and I plucked up the courage to ask her out. She tells me no but that I'm really sweet and that she's sorry it's how she feels. She also added that if I gave her a few months, "maybe" she'd develop feelings for me.

About a month later, I'm still madly in love with this girl and decide to try again. I wrote a song about her and sent it to her,  which she said she really liked so I got more hopeful. I wrote another one (looking back the lyrics are quite cringy) and sent it. She liked it and said no one had said things so nice about her. She was really keeping my hopes up (and we did flirt a bit anyway) but still doesn't like me.

Around another month later I write a letter straight from my heart to her about how I really feel. This letter contains some pretty deep stuff, and I make sure to put it in an envelope and pit "READ WHEN ALONE" on it. Her being stupid she opens it and reads it while in a lesson at school when her friends are around her. The rest of the class hear (because she's reading it out loud) and eventually the teacher catches on and goes to one of the heads of year because they're concerned (she actually texted me later saying the letter was sweet but she already knew my feelings for her and didn't need the letter).

The school then starts an investigation and talk to the girl and she tells them about me asking her out and writing the songs (I think she told them about everything because we had a falling out a few days before). They decide that I've don't something really wrong. They make me go to see a doctor to talk about the situation (or else they'd bring someone in to talk to me). I get a day in insolation (in a room for the whole day in silence doing work) and the news spreads and people gossip about it for the next few months.

Basically, my friends all think this is creepy but I say I was just doing it out of true love and that they don't know what it feels like. Bare in mind I have come to kind of regret it now. I didn't intend on anything bad happening and I'd really like some opinions.

AITA for kicking my girlfriend out of the house? | Throwaway account because, reasons.

So my girlfriend and I have been dating for about 2 years now, and we decided to move in together last month, to see whether we’re actually ready to stay together for the rest of our lives.

Things have been going pretty great between us and we were both thinking about marriage.

But after we’ve moved in together, a couple of issues have risen. I know all couples have problems, but these don’t seem to be normal problems.

For example, we have different schedules. I’m more of a sleep-in kind of guy, while she’s a morning person. I’m fine with that, but she has been trying to get me to wake up earlier, saying that it’s healthy and whatnot.

Then, she’s vegetarian and I love meat. I have to have meat once a week, but she can’t stand it. She refuses to eat with me whenever I eat meat, and sometimes she refuses to sit in the same room as me later on, saying that “she can smell my chicken breath” or something.

There have been a couple more issues too around the house, and it’s become pretty clear to me that it’s not going to work out.

Now, I paid almost the entire amount for the house, while she chipped in maybe a small amount. Since I’ve spent a lot of money on the apartment, I want to stay there and continue my life. So, I told her that it wasn’t going to work out and told her to leave as soon as she could.

Well, she claims that “the house is hers too” and that the two of us can fix our problems.

I know it’s only been a month, but I’ve found out many things about her ever since we’ve moved in together, not necessarily bad, just habits and stuff I didn’t know before. And I really don’t think we should waste any more time together.

So far, this was all to justify why I kicked her out. Yep, I know it’s rather long but just bear with me.

So anyway, she refused to leave, even when I agreed to pay her back the amount she put in for the house. So I forced her to leave, and she had no choice but to go back to her parents’ house.

Now, her parents have called me and told me that what I’m doing is “asshole behaviour” (not the term they used, but to fit the sub). My apartment is a pretty nice place, and she’s old enough to get her own place, but I’m guessing they want the apartment since it’s in a prime location.

I can understand why they would think I’m the bad guy, since they’re her parents. But my parents have said that it wasn’t my right to kick her out too. However, I feel that the house is mine since i’m paying her back, I have paid the full amount for the house.

So, Reddit, AITA for kicking my girlfriend out of my house?

AITA for refusing to use a “trading” system in my own home? | I’m [17] living with my [23] brother and my [45] mother in a three bedroom home. Every single aspect of our house is overseen by my brother. He’s extremely cheap with his money and requires us to use a system he created where we trade him monopoly money for goods in the house. This includes, paper plates, paper towels, toilet paper, toothpaste, snacks, drinks and anything else that normally would be in cabinets in a house he stores in his closet.

My brother works and contributes to about 5% of the groceries in the house, my mom supporting us with the other 95% from her retirement fund from the Navy. He justifies him buying a couple items means he gets to control all the goods in the house. We’ve been doing this system for about 4 months now and I’m on wits end. I feel absolutely demeaned when I need to keep track and use Monopoly money when I need some dental floss or toilet paper, I use a lot because I get frequent nose bleeds, so I often run out of money and need to use old rags from my garage.

We’re by no means poor, my mom is just frugal, nowhere to the extent of my brother, but she buys anything we need and we have everything we need but my brother holds it behind his closet and guards it like a security guard, it’s ridiculous. So earlier today I ran out of toothpaste so I went to my brother with a torn Monopoly money, (we’ve had this same game for 5 years so the money is worn as well) and he said it’s unusable because of its condition. I told him he’s being a complete asshole and he has a god complex for caring so much about a made up currency.

My mom has this kind of keep the peace viewpoint with us so she goes along with the system and sneaks me snacks and things that she needs to buy secretly, because my brother waits for our mom to get back from the store by the front door and helps her bring them all up to his room. She’s upset that we’re fighting and has kindly asked if this is something worth arguing for, after that I’ve been thinking about it a lot and need advice, so Reddit...

Am I the asshole here?

AITA for not changing my ceremony time for my grandma | I (27 F) got engaged late December 2019. My grandma had called me and asked that I not book my wedding between a couple dates - one early 2020 and one end of July 2020. I told her I don’t think I’ll be planning it for either of those times.

Side note: my mother told me to not worry about planning around my grandma. That I should have my wedding whenever it suits me. But I do want my grandma at my wedding.

Fast forward to last week. We have viewed several venues, most of which are booked up in 2020 and even some into 2021. We found a place I love and decided on August 1st date. The had a couple other openings in August but this date would not conflict with some unknown travel dates of my fiancé.

Today my grandma called saying how sad she was that we booked August 1st, as that is the date they will be porting from their cruise. She didn’t say what time, but she looked at flights and was worried she would not make it to the ceremony.

Per the venue, a typical ceremony is around 5:30-6pm. The flight my grandma found would arrive around 4:30, and takes maybe an hour to get to the venue from airport.

She asked me to move my ceremony start time back to 6:30. I didn’t outright say no, but I think that’s too late for a ceremony to start.

I asked her about canceling her cruise. (Note she goes on several cruises every year). She told me it’s a “once in a lifetime” trip and she didn’t want to miss it since she’s getting old. I kindly told her that my wedding is also once in a lifetime and that if she couldn’t find a suitable flight, she would have to choose. I even offered to help her find flights. The flights are limited, I’ll admit. And not knowing what time her cruise boards, it’s hard to help. There was one flight that would work, but it would be tight timing.

I feel awful for choosing a wedding date that conflicts with her plans, but we were limited on dates/venues. She also told me not to do the wedding at the end of July. I don’t remember if she gave me exact dates.

So, am I the asshole for not wanting to push back my ceremony time for her? And am I an asshole for picking a date without asking her about it?

AITA for refusing to help my mom on this project? | Over the past three weeks my sister and I've been painting my parent's house. We started in the dining room then moved to the large entryway/living room area which requires us the work on scaffolding as the walls are so high. it's also a really awkward room with lots of ornate moulding. It's been a grueling few weeks and my mom gets really angry whenever we ask for a break. We've had 2 breaks in this time, and she still brings it up as us being lazy.

I started this project being really upfront with her: I want to be able to fit in reasonable stopping points between projects. Aka I'm starting this project ONLY and once I'm done I want a break to focus on myself for a few days before moving on to the next project. I don't mind doing these projects but I want to spend time for myself too.

I said that because she likes to start projects then feverishly push people to finish them. Then she starts another project in the middle of the first project, then another, so the cycle of work never really ends, and god forbid you take a break with something unfinished. It's also a really chaotic method of working. I prefer doing things orderly as it keeps my own anxiety down.

Well, mom decided to start painting the kitchen (of course.) She claimed it was just her own project and that we don't have to help her. Thing is she can't do much because of her health, so she constantly asks us to stop what we're doing and help her. I told her over and over again that I'm not willing to start on the kitchen until I finish the front room. She seemed to relent with that at first.

This morning though mom came to me and said, "hey can you ask your sister to help me tape around the cabinets?" I was hesitant because my sister is even less enthusiastic about these projects than I am.

Of course my sister refused because it's just too much work right now, but mom flew off the handle. She was calling us lazy and ungreatful. she was throwing insult after insult, and denying any of the work we've done so far.

*"You only do these things because I'll scream at you if you don't!"*

We had a similar fight before when my mom and I disagreed on the exact method for painting the dining room (paint one half of the room, than the other. Moving the furnature in between)

My oldest sibling who doesn't live here anymore was trying to give me advise about it and said, "Treat this like an improv show. You always want to say *yes, but* but that's the same as saying *no*. Try saying *yes, and* instead."

I just don't understand her logic though. While "yes and" can prevent a fight in the short term, it has been wrecking my mental health trying to keep up with mom's demands. if I say "yes and when would be a good time to start?" she'll say "right now". If I ask for a break I'm crewed out unless I literally have a panic attack. If I don't put my foot down about her parrallel projects, then I'll start having a mental break down.

AITA for refusing to help her start this other project? Am I being too particular?
